baseline.policy: Use the current broad-market price-floor, low-extension, high-volatility trend-persistence paper eligibility and score with its frozen universe, next-open clock, notional, costs and exits.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most one existing paper cash slot; positive-contribution ticker share below 40% and partner share below 50%; no portfolio allocation, production signal or order effect
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Repository cash-equity commission and slippage assumptions at identical notional; no financing, borrow credit or option carry
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: HALO common stock for the current lead; any future cohort remains long common equity only, with no option, leverage, inverse product, proxy or short leg
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Canonical OHLCV, next-regular-session-open availability, gap-cancel, stale-price and minimum-liquidity controls must pass
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Issuer release acceptance, effective partner-product relationships, product-sales and royalty fields, price inputs, universe membership and any independent market prior must be known before each simulated decision open

candidate.falsifier: Reject or park if no observable market prior can separate expected from surprising conversion; if partner-product relationships, sales and royalty definitions cannot be frozen effective-dated and as-known; if partner sales do not transmit to comparable HALO royalty observations; if any standard window has fewer than five executable treatment decisions; if D0-D3 finds a frozen near-neighbor; if one ticker exceeds 40% or one partner exceeds 50% of positive treatment value; or if H10 and H20 replacement value does not beat cash, SPY, QQQ and the unconditioned broad-market row after identical costs.
candidate.hypothesis: For the previously preregistered current HALO broad-market price-leadership row, when source-dated evidence known before the next decision open confirms effective named partner-product commercialization and comparable recurring HALO royalty conversion rather than only a one-off approval headline, the move may persist over fixed next-open H10 and H20 horizons; keep broad-market eligibility and score unchanged and use the condition only as a deterministic research admission tag.
candidate.replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash, identical-interval SPY and QQQ, and the exact unconditioned broad-market paper row at the same decision clock, notional, costs and exit policy.
candidate.title: HALO partner-product royalty-conversion continuation lead

treatment.policy: Keep broad-market eligibility and score unchanged. Attach a research admission tag only when source-dated evidence known before the decision open binds an effective HALO-to-named-partner-to-product relationship, commercialization evidence and a comparable recurring royalty-conversion observation; otherwise abstain. Evaluate fixed H10 and H20 horizons.

candidate.why_not_arbitraged: The Q2 royalty acceleration, raised guidance and partner sales were public before the frozen next-open decision. A residual edge can exist only if investors underweight the durability and capital efficiency of conversion royalties relative to one-off approval or earnings momentum, and it must survive independent market-prior, source, PIT, transmission, touch-density, novelty, concentration and exact replacement-value tests rather than rely on the issuer narrative.

decision.rationale: All four roles agree that named partner commercialization and subcutaneous conversion create a real capital-light royalty mechanism and that all cited facts were known before the next decision open. They also agree that the August 6 issuer event was already public before the price row, while observable expectations, independent transmission, canonical PIT, touch density, concentration, novelty, settled replacement value and portfolio opportunity cost remain exclusively for authoritative D0-D3 qualification without override or trade authority.

researchability.basis: Current HALO, SEC, FDA and named-partner primary disclosures establish a real partner-funded subcutaneous-delivery and royalty mechanism, and the Q2 2026 earnings release was public before the frozen next-open decision. However, the same release immediately preceded the current price-leadership row, no independent observable expectation gap is bound, partner franchise sales do not consistently separate intravenous from ENHANZE-enabled subcutaneous forms, and canonical historical as-known relationship, royalty and market-prior vintages are absent. The card is therefore lead-only and cannot establish admission or a trade.
limitations: The August 6 earnings release already disclosed the royalty acceleration and raised guidance before the August 7 price row, so issuer evidence explains the move but does not identify an unpriced expectation gap.

Partner disclosures mix quarter and half-year periods, USD and CHF, reported and constant-currency growth, and in several cases intravenous and subcutaneous franchise sales; they cannot be mechanically converted into HALO royalty revenue.

HALO estimates sales-based royalties before final partner reports, applies later true-ups, and reclassifies qualifying currency hedges into royalty revenue, so product-sales and royalty clocks are economically aligned but not numerically interchangeable.
No immutable canonical historical filing corpus, effective-dated partner-product map, consensus prior or machine replay with known_at enforcement is bound.
The current issuer observation provides one candidate, not five executable treatment touches in every canonical window, and current replacement value is unsettled.
Registered derivatives, flow, revisions and positioning evidence has no HALO candidate overlap and is not gate-ready.
Royalty concentration, approximately $1.916 billion of net debt and the second-half guidance ramp remain material counterweights.
Current live position control blocks additions and production signals are empty, so cash/no-new-entry remains the executable opportunity-cost winner.

business_analyst.conclusion: HALO has a coherent partner-funded, capital-light recurring-revenue model: partners develop and commercialize ENHANZE-enabled products, while HALO receives royalties, milestones and API economics. Current partner sales and subcutaneous conversion support the mechanism, but the August 6 HALO release publicly disclosed the same acceleration immediately before the price-leadership row. The evidence is therefore explanatory and market-known, not an independently identified continuation edge.

evidence.claim: HALO reported Q2 2026 royalty revenue of $307.699 million, up 49.6% year over year, attributed mainly to VYVGART Hytrulo, DARZALEX SC and recently launched products; it raised full-year royalty guidance to $1.220-$1.245 billion. The release and call occurred on August 6 before the next decision open.

HALO's official ENHANZE partner page identifies ten commercial partnered products, more than one million patients in over 100 markets, and links named products from Janssen, argenx, Roche, Bristol Myers Squibb and Takeda to its rHuPH20 platform.

Johnson & Johnson reported Q2 2026 worldwide DARZALEX franchise sales of $4.207 billion, up 18.9% reported, supporting a large underlying franchise but not separating intravenous from FASPRO sales for a direct HALO royalty bridge.

argenx reported Q2 2026 VYVGART global product net sales of about $1.5 billion, up 60% year over year, and confirmed that VYVGART Hytrulo is the subcutaneous combination using Halozyme rHuPH20; total franchise sales still combine delivery forms.

Roche reported H1 2026 Phesgo sales of CHF 1.318 billion, up 18% at constant exchange rates, and explicitly described European Perjeta declines as partly reflecting conversion to Phesgo; the half-year CHF clock cannot be directly mapped to HALO's quarterly USD royalties.

business_analyst.uncertainty: Product-level royalty rates, regional step-downs, true-ups, currency effects and subcutaneous shares are not consistently disclosed. The business mechanism is falsified as an alpha if the market-known earnings event contains all relevant information, if partner product growth does not transmit to comparable HALO royalties, or if a multi-issuer cohort cannot satisfy touch and concentration limits.

financial_analyst.conclusion: Q2 2026 financial momentum is strong and cross-checks closely across independent source groups: total revenue rose 47.7% and royalty revenue 49.6%, with guidance raised. The counterweights are approximately $1.916 billion of net debt, a second-half royalty ramp above Q2, concentrated partner economics, mixed accounting clocks and non-GAAP guidance. These facts support a research lead but do not isolate incremental price continuation.

evidence.claim: For Q2 2026, HALO reported $480.999 million total revenue, $307.699 million royalties, $287.654 million operating income and $229.913 million GAAP net income. It raised the midpoints of total-revenue, royalty, adjusted-EBITDA and non-GAAP EPS guidance by approximately 6.39%, 7.17%, 7.51% and 10.31%, respectively.

Fiscal.ai/StockAnalysis independently reports Q2 revenue, royalty revenue, net income and debt within 0.02% of HALO's release; its $231.00 million cash figure matches unrestricted cash plus marketable securities rather than the issuer headline that also includes restricted cash.

HALO's Q1 2026 10-Q states that sales-based royalties are recognized in the underlying sales quarter using estimates or preliminary partner reports before final reports, with later true-ups, and that qualifying currency-hedge gains and losses are reclassified into royalty revenue in the same period.

J&J reported $4.207 billion of Q2 DARZALEX worldwide sales, and Genmab independently reported the same value, a zero difference; this validates the franchise total but not the ENHANZE-enabled share or HALO's effective royalty rate.

At June 30, HALO had $231.003 million of unrestricted cash and marketable securities against $2.146654 billion of current and long-term debt, implying about $1.915651 billion of net debt. H1 royalties of $548.380 million imply H2 quarterly royalties of roughly $335.8-$348.3 million to reach guidance, 9.1%-13.2% above Q2.

financial_analyst.uncertainty: The Q2 release is unaudited, product-level royalty amounts and concentration are not fully presented in the primary release, and partner franchise sales often combine IV and SC delivery. A canonical replay must preserve the original release clocks, units, currencies, product definitions and later true-ups rather than substitute current mappings.

industry_researcher.conclusion: Subcutaneous conversion is a real industry transmission channel: ENHANZE appears in ten commercial products, partner franchises are growing, and Roche explicitly reports conversion from Perjeta to Phesgo. Yet the public relation map is a current snapshot rather than a complete effective-dated history, older franchises face erosion and litigation or patent outcomes can alter duration. No independent market prior separates expected conversion from surprise at the frozen decision clock.

evidence.claim: HALO's official registry lists commercial ENHANZE products including DARZALEX FASPRO/SC, VYVGART Hytrulo, Phesgo, Tecentriq Hybreza/SC, Ocrevus Zunovo/SC, Opdivo Qvantig and Rybrevant FASPRO/SC across named partners and regions.

argenx states that VYVGART Hytrulo combines efgartigimod alfa with Halozyme recombinant human hyaluronidase PH20 and that the expanded all-serotype gMG label launched in Q2 2026, providing a named product-to-platform transmission link.

Roche identifies Phesgo as a top growth driver and attributes part of Perjeta's European decline to patient conversion to Phesgo, directly supporting a subcutaneous conversion mechanism; disclosed H1 sales are not a HALO royalty observation.

HALO's Q2 release says five new ENHANZE and Hypercon collaborations had been signed through July, exceeding its annual deal goal, while recently launched products contributed to royalty growth; development-stage agreements create long-duration optionality but not near-term settled royalties.

HALO's Q1 2026 filing says royalty growth was driven predominantly by DARZALEX SC, VYVGART Hytrulo and Phesgo while older Herceptin and MabThera products faced modest price erosion, showing both concentration and lifecycle offsets within the same platform.

industry_researcher.uncertainty: The current partner page does not supply a complete effective-dated relationship history, and partner franchise sales cannot consistently isolate ENHANZE-enabled volume. The transmission claim fails if source-dated partner product changes do not precede and explain comparable HALO royalty observations, if no observable market prior exists, or if patent, regulatory, pricing and concentration risks dominate the conversion benefit.

risk_assessor.conclusion: The economic mechanism and current financial facts are coherent enough to submit as a lead, but the main evidence was publicly released immediately before the price move, so it is not independent of the market reaction. The frozen contract remains snapshot-only, current replacement value is pending, derivatives and positioning have no overlap, historical PIT and touch density are absent, and portfolio controls block additions. D0-D3 must fail closed unless those contracts independently pass.

evidence.claim: The frozen outcome-blind snapshot records HALO as the previously preregistered adjacent lead from the unchanged August 7 broad-market paper cross-section, with replacement_value_pending=true, paper_only=true and trade_enabled=false; it includes no future return, PnL or Gate field.

The frozen surface registry labels the price and issuer roots snapshot_only with zero settled decisions; issuer roots have zero independent observations, while the registered derivatives, flow and positioning context has zero HALO overlap and is parked.

The readiness artifact contains thirteen registered lanes and no ready lane; short-volume Q5 remains at 18 of 20 settlements and no mature derivatives, revisions, Form 4 or independent conflict cohort can be borrowed for HALO.

Current position control has ok_to_add_control_pass=false because daily-report controls are missing and a target is stale; production and pilot signal arrays are empty, so cash/no-new-entry is the executable comparator.

HALO released the Q2 royalty beat and raised guidance on August 6 before the August 7 price-leadership row. The same issuer facts can explain the move but cannot by themselves identify an incremental expectation gap or causal next-open continuation transmission.

risk_assessor.uncertainty: Historical relation clocks, market expectations, product-level royalty definitions, touch density, concentration, factor exposure and portfolio covariance remain unresolved. Any replay using current partner mappings or revised disclosures without known_at enforcement would be not_pit, and a single-issuer result would breach the preregistered contribution cap.

subject.research_question: For the previously preregistered current HALO broad-market paper row, does source-dated named partner-product commercialization and subcutaneous conversion identify a durable capital-light royalty continuation mechanism beyond the already public August 6 earnings event over fixed next-open H10/H20 replacement value?
